description: Defines types and constants related to Radio Bearer IDs (SRB and DRB) in 3GPP LTE/NR specifications, including enums, conversion functions, and formatters.

classes.name: rb_id_t
classes.description: Represents a Radio Bearer ID, which can be either SRB or DRB, with methods to identify and retrieve the specific ID.

methods.name: srb_id_to_uint
methods.description: Converts srb_id_t enum to its underlying integer value.

methods.name: int_to_srb_id
methods.description: Converts an integer to srb_id_t enum.

methods.name: to_srb_id
methods.description: Converts an lcid_t to srb_id_t if applicable.

methods.name: drb_id_to_uint
methods.description: Converts drb_id_t enum to its uint8_t value.
